uncovered_production_bugs.evidence: In val-full-session-decisions-vi (web=False & web=True), the map call extracted all 4 gold decisions with valid supports ([S13], [S79], [S155]) plus a 5th item noting no third-party legal contract code was mentioned with supports=[]. _items() raised ValueError('invalid_map_support'), causing aggregate_session to discard the entire batch (visited=0/220, reason=map_not_ready, answer=UNKNOWN).

uncovered_production_bugs.summary: 30,000-token map batch size vs 60,000ms per-call timeout cap in BudgetedLLM causes APITimeoutError on full-session English timeline
uncovered_production_bugs.evidence: In val-full-session-timeline-en (web=False & web=True, 240 messages), _batches() packed all 240 messages (~29,874 input tokens) into a single non-streaming llm.complete call (input_limit=30000), while BudgetedLLM.__init__ hard-capped llm_timeout_ms to min(settings.llm_timeout_ms, 60000). Both calls timed out at ~61.34s / ~61.81s (status=run.failed, error_code=generation_failed, accounting_complete=False).
